spec.title: Tariff Impact Tracker: Daily Effective Tariff Rate
spec.subtitle: Percent

body_html: Published in the original release as Figure 2, "Tariff Impact Tracker: Daily Effective Tariff Rate by Authority." The source data is a single aggregate ETR series (no per-authority breakdown columns despite the title), running daily from January 1, 2025 through the end of 2026. Section 122 Expires scenario only -- no counterpart exists for Section 122 Extended in the source.
note: No counterpart anywhere in the previous-vintages structure; included as an additional figure. Section 122 Expires scenario only.
